product_overview: Ray is a hyper-modern multi-vendor marketplace and business operating platform for Egypt, supporting customers, merchants, couriers, portal users, and administrators in one bilingual ecosystem. It provides storefront management, ordering, delivery tracking, analytics, AI-assisted design, and platform administration through a web SPA and Electron desktop app.
core_goals: Enable secure multi-role authentication and role-based access control for customers, merchants, couriers, admins, and portal users.
Provide merchants with end-to-end shop, product, offer, reservation, gallery, and analytics management.
Support order lifecycle management, delivery assignment, courier status updates, and invoice generation.
Deliver customer-facing discovery features including search, shop browsing, offers, feedback, notifications, and support.
Offer admin workflows for approvals, user management, shop moderation, support, and platform analytics.
Provide AI-powered store design tools for theme, page, brand, chat-based editing, and visual editing.
Support portal and map-listing management for location-based business discovery and branch operations.

features.name: Authentication
features.description: Users can register, log in, manage sessions, verify email, reset passwords, and access role-protected areas of the platform.
user_flows: POST /api/v1/auth/signup with valid customer or merchant details -> Receive 201 with created account payload -> GET /api/v1/auth/session -> Receive 200 with current user session
POST /api/v1/auth/login with valid email and password -> Receive 200 with authenticated session/JWT payload -> POST /api/v1/auth/logout -> Receive 200 confirming session cleared

POST /api/v1/auth/password/forgot with a registered email -> Receive 200 confirming reset email request -> POST /api/v1/auth/password/reset with valid token and new password -> Receive 200 confirming password reset
POST /api/v1/auth/login with invalid credentials -> Receive 401 Unauthorized -> GET /api/v1/auth/session without a valid session -> Receive 200 with empty or unauthenticated session state

features.name: Shop Management
features.description: Merchants and admins can create, update, review, approve, and analyze shops, including banners, design settings, and module upgrade requests.
user_flows: POST /api/v1/shops with authenticated merchant data -> Receive 201 with new shop record -> GET /api/v1/shops/me -> Receive 200 with the merchant's current shop -> PATCH /api/v1/shops/me with updated settings -> Receive 200 with updated shop details

GET /api/v1/shops with no authentication -> Receive 200 with the active shops list -> GET /api/v1/shops/:slug for a valid shop slug -> Receive 200 with shop profile data -> POST /api/v1/shops/:id/visit -> Receive 200 confirming visit tracking

GET /api/v1/shops/admin/list with admin credentials -> Receive 200 with shops by status -> PATCH /api/v1/shops/admin/:id/status with approve/reject/suspend action -> Receive 200 with updated moderation status
GET /api/v1/shops/:slug for an unknown slug -> Receive 404 Not found -> PATCH /api/v1/shops/me/banner without proper ownership or auth -> Receive error response denying unauthorized update

features.name: Product Management
features.description: Merchants manage products with pricing, stock, images, and category details for their shops.
user_flows: POST /api/v1/products with authenticated merchant and valid shopId, name, price, stock, category, imageUrl, and description -> Receive 201 with created product -> GET /api/v1/products/manage/by-shop/:shopId -> Receive 200 with shop product list -> PATCH /api/v1/products/:id -> Receive 200 with updated product
GET /api/v1/products -> Receive 200 with active products list -> GET /api/v1/products/:id for a valid ID -> Receive 200 with product details

POST /api/v1/products with missing or invalid required fields -> Receive 400 Validation error -> PATCH /api/v1/products/:id without authorization -> Receive error response denying access -> DELETE /api/v1/products/:id without authorization -> Receive error response denying access

features.name: Order Management
features.description: Orders can be created, tracked, updated by merchants, and used to manage returns across the order lifecycle.
user_flows: POST /api/v1/orders with authenticated customer order details -> Receive 201 with created order -> GET /api/v1/orders/me as a merchant -> Receive 200 with current shop orders -> PATCH /api/v1/orders/:id/status -> Receive 200 with updated order status

GET /api/v1/orders by an authorized merchant or admin -> Receive 200 with shop order list -> POST /api/v1/orders/:id/returns with return request data -> Receive 201 with created return -> GET /api/v1/orders/:id/returns -> Receive 200 with return list

POST /api/v1/orders with invalid or incomplete order data -> Receive error response indicating validation failure -> PATCH /api/v1/orders/:id/status without authorization -> Receive error response denying access

features.name: Reservation and Booking
features.description: Merchants can create booking-enabled reservations and manage reservation status, while customers can view their own bookings.
user_flows: POST /api/v1/reservations with authenticated user reservation details -> Receive 201 with created reservation -> GET /api/v1/reservations/me -> Receive 200 with current user's reservations
GET /api/v1/reservations by an authorized merchant -> Receive 200 with reservations for the shop -> PATCH /api/v1/reservations/:id/status -> Receive 200 with updated reservation status

POST /api/v1/reservations with invalid timing or missing required data -> Receive error response indicating validation failure -> PATCH /api/v1/reservations/:id/status without authorization -> Receive error response denying access

features.name: Offer Management
features.description: Merchants can create, update, list, and delete promotional offers such as discounts and bundles.
user_flows: GET /api/v1/offers -> Receive 200 with active offers list -> POST /api/v1/offers with authenticated merchant offer details -> Receive 201 with created offer -> PATCH /api/v1/offers/:id -> Receive 200 with updated offer
DELETE /api/v1/offers/:id with authenticated merchant ownership -> Receive 200 confirming deletion -> GET /api/v1/offers -> Receive 200 with refreshed active offers list

POST /api/v1/offers without authentication -> Receive error response denying access -> PATCH /api/v1/offers/:id with invalid data -> Receive error response indicating validation or authorization failure

features.name: Media Upload
features.description: Authenticated users can upload media through presigned URLs, direct upload, and compression workflows for storefront and product assets.
user_flows: POST /api/v1/media/presign with authenticated file metadata -> Receive 200 with presigned upload URL -> Use returned upload URL to store file in S3 -> POST /api/v1/media/upload to finalize direct upload -> Receive 200 with uploaded file details
POST /api/v1/media/compress with authenticated image file -> Receive 200 with optimized/compressed media metadata
POST /api/v1/media/presign without authentication -> Receive error response denying access -> POST /api/v1/media/upload with invalid file payload -> Receive error response indicating upload failure

features.name: Gallery Management
features.description: Merchants manage shop galleries by adding and removing images visible on shop pages.
user_flows: POST /api/v1/gallery with authenticated merchant image data -> Receive 201 with gallery item created -> GET /api/v1/gallery -> Receive 200 with gallery images for the shop
DELETE /api/v1/gallery/:id with authenticated merchant ownership -> Receive 200 confirming gallery item removal -> GET /api/v1/gallery -> Receive 200 with updated gallery list
POST /api/v1/gallery without authentication -> Receive error response denying access -> DELETE /api/v1/gallery/:id for a missing item -> Receive error response indicating not found

features.name: Notifications
features.description: Users can retrieve notifications and mark them as read individually or in bulk.
user_flows: GET /api/v1/notifications with authenticated user -> Receive 200 with notification list -> PATCH /api/v1/notifications/:id/read -> Receive 200 confirming notification marked read -> PATCH /api/v1/notifications/read-all -> Receive 200 confirming all notifications read

GET /api/v1/notifications without authentication -> Receive error response denying access -> PATCH /api/v1/notifications/:id/read with invalid ID -> Receive error response indicating not found or invalid resource

features.name: Analytics
features.description: Merchants and admins can view overview, sales, and product performance analytics for a shop.
user_flows: GET /api/v1/analytics/overview with authenticated merchant -> Receive 200 with analytics overview -> GET /api/v1/analytics/sales -> Receive 200 with sales metrics -> GET /api/v1/analytics/products -> Receive 200 with product performance data

GET /api/v1/analytics/overview without authentication -> Receive error response denying access -> GET /api/v1/analytics/sales for a shop without permission -> Receive error response denying access or ownership failure

features.name: AI Builder
features.description: Merchants can generate themes, page schemas, brand identity, and iterative design changes using AI-assisted endpoints.
user_flows: POST /api/v1/ai/builder/generate-theme with authenticated shop context and prompt -> Receive 200 with JSON theme output -> POST /api/v1/ai/builder/generate-pages -> Receive 200 with generated page schemas -> POST /api/v1/ai/builder/chat with follow-up design instructions -> Receive 200 with updated design response

POST /api/v1/ai/builder/generate-brand with authenticated brand prompt -> Receive 200 with brand identity JSON -> POST /api/v1/ai/builder/visual-edit with element target and instructions -> Receive 200 with visual edit token changes

POST /api/v1/ai/builder/chat without authentication -> Receive error response denying access -> POST /api/v1/ai/builder/generate-theme with malformed prompt data -> Receive error response indicating validation failure

features.name: Support and Customer Service
features.description: Customers and authenticated users can create support tickets, while admins manage replies, status, priority, and deletion.
user_flows: POST /api/v1/support/public with public support message -> Receive 201 with created public ticket -> POST /api/v1/support with authenticated user ticket details -> Receive 201 with created authenticated ticket -> GET /api/v1/support/mine -> Receive 200 with the user's tickets

GET /api/v1/support/admin with admin credentials -> Receive 200 with all support tickets -> PATCH /api/v1/support/admin/:id/reply -> Receive 200 with admin reply saved -> PATCH /api/v1/support/admin/:id/status -> Receive 200 with updated ticket status -> PATCH /api/v1/support/admin/:id/priority -> Receive 200 with updated priority
POST /api/v1/support with no authentication -> Receive error response denying access -> PATCH /api/v1/support/admin/:id/reply with non-admin credentials -> Receive error response denying access

features.name: User Management
features.description: Admins can manage user profiles and courier accounts, including approvals, status changes, and courier creation.
user_flows: PATCH /api/v1/users/me with authenticated user profile updates -> Receive 200 with updated profile -> GET /api/v1/users/couriers with admin credentials -> Receive 200 with courier list -> POST /api/v1/users/couriers -> Receive 201 with created courier account

GET /api/v1/users/couriers/pending with admin credentials -> Receive 200 with pending courier approvals -> PATCH /api/v1/users/couriers/:id/approve -> Receive 200 with courier approved -> PATCH /api/v1/users/couriers/:id/status -> Receive 200 with updated active status
PATCH /api/v1/users/me without authentication -> Receive error response denying access -> PATCH /api/v1/users/couriers/:id/reject with non-admin credentials -> Receive error response denying access

features.name: Courier Delivery
features.description: Couriers can view available orders, accept deliveries, update delivery status, and inspect earnings.
user_flows: GET /api/v1/courier/orders with authenticated courier -> Receive 200 with available and assigned orders -> PATCH /api/v1/courier/orders/:id/accept -> Receive 200 confirming delivery acceptance -> PATCH /api/v1/courier/orders/:id/status -> Receive 200 with updated delivery status -> GET /api/v1/courier/earnings -> Receive 200 with earnings summary

GET /api/v1/courier/orders without courier authentication -> Receive error response denying access -> PATCH /api/v1/courier/orders/:id/status for an unassigned order -> Receive error response indicating authorization or assignment failure

features.name: Map Listings
features.description: Public users can browse map listings, while authenticated users can create and update map listings.
user_flows: GET /api/v1/map-listings -> Receive 200 with map listings array -> GET /api/v1/map-listings/:id for a valid listing -> Receive 200 with listing detail -> POST /api/v1/map-listings with authenticated listing data -> Receive 201 with created map listing -> PATCH /api/v1/map-listings/:id -> Receive 200 with updated listing
GET /api/v1/map-listings/:id for an unknown listing -> Receive error response indicating not found -> POST /api/v1/map-listings without authentication -> Receive error response denying access

features.name: Portal
features.description: Portal users can manage listings and view portal analytics for map-based business operations.
user_flows: GET /api/v1/portal/listings with authenticated portal user -> Receive 200 with portal listings -> POST /api/v1/portal/listings -> Receive 201 with created portal listing -> PATCH /api/v1/portal/listings/:id -> Receive 200 with updated portal listing -> GET /api/v1/portal/analytics -> Receive 200 with analytics data

PATCH /api/v1/portal/listings/:id without authentication -> Receive error response denying access -> POST /api/v1/portal/listings with invalid payload -> Receive error response indicating validation failure

features.name: Search
features.description: Users can search products and shops across the marketplace using full-text search and filters.
user_flows: GET /api/v1/search with query and filters -> Receive 200 with matched products and shops -> Refine query parameters in GET /api/v1/search -> Receive 200 with updated search results
GET /api/v1/search with empty or malformed query parameters -> Receive 200 with empty or limited results, or an error response depending on validation rules

features.name: Feedback
features.description: Authenticated users can submit feedback, and visitors can browse existing feedback entries.
user_flows: GET /api/v1/feedback -> Receive 200 with feedback list -> POST /api/v1/feedback with authenticated user review data -> Receive 201 with submitted feedback
POST /api/v1/feedback without authentication -> Receive error response denying access -> GET /api/v1/feedback with no matching entries -> Receive 200 with an empty list or no results

features.name: Invoice
features.description: Merchants can generate invoices for orders and retrieve invoices for their shops.
user_flows: POST /api/v1/invoices with authenticated merchant and valid order reference -> Receive 201 with generated invoice -> GET /api/v1/invoices -> Receive 200 with invoice list -> GET /api/v1/invoices/:id -> Receive 200 with invoice details
POST /api/v1/invoices with missing order reference -> Receive error response indicating validation failure -> GET /api/v1/invoices/:id without authorization -> Receive error response denying access

features.name: Health Check
features.description: The system exposes a public health endpoint for basic service monitoring.
user_flows: GET /api/v1/health -> Receive 200 with system health status
GET /api/v1/health during service disruption -> Receive non-200 error response or degraded health payload

features.name: Monitoring
features.description: Operations teams can inspect system health, metrics, queue statistics, and cache statistics through public monitoring endpoints.
user_flows: GET /monitoring/health -> Receive 200 with monitoring health payload -> GET /monitoring/metrics -> Receive 200 with Prometheus metrics text -> GET /monitoring/queue/stats -> Receive 200 with queue statistics -> GET /monitoring/cache/stats -> Receive 200 with cache statistics

GET /monitoring/metrics during an unavailable metrics service -> Receive error response or partial metrics output -> GET /monitoring/cache/stats with backend cache failure -> Receive error response or degraded cache stats payload
